Title: Frequently asked questions
Subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about our products and services.
Question1: When do I need to register for VAT in Switzerland?
Answer1: You must register for VAT when your worldwide turnover exceeds CHF 100,000 per year. Some activities are exempt. We confirm your status and handle the registration and returns.
Question2: Withholding tax in Geneva: Who is affected and which scale applies?
Answer2: Withholding tax applies to employees without a C permit or not domiciled in Switzerland, based on the canton of work. In Geneva, the scale depends on family status and workload. We configure payroll and check the correct scales.
Question3: What social charges should I budget for an employee in Switzerland?
Answer3: Plan for AHV/AVS, DI/AI/APG, unemployment (ALV/AC), pension fund (BVG/LPP if threshold), accident insurance (LAA), and family allowances. Rates vary by canton and funds. We estimate your employer cost and secure your filings.
Question4: Geneva minimum wage: Am I concerned and how do I apply it?
Answer4: The Geneva minimum wage applies to most sectors. It must be respected pro‑rata based on workload and hours. We check eligibility and adjust payslips accordingly.
Question5: Swiss QR invoice: What are the accounting requirements?
Answer5: The QR invoice replaced the red/orange slips. Your invoices must show the QR code and required legal mentions. We update your templates, VAT accounts, and bank integration for smooth reconciliation.
Question6: How do you integrate Odoo with Swiss banking?
Answer6: We configure Odoo for Swiss bank files and reconciliations, including pain.001 payment orders, camt.053 statements, QR invoices, and the Swiss chart of accounts. We connect your banking flows, validate VAT mappings, and test month-end reconciliation so your finance team can keep daily visibility without breaking Swiss compliance.
Question7: Can we delegate specific accounting tasks while handling others ourselves?
Answer7: Absolutely. Our Odoo-based service model is designed for flexibility. You can manage tasks like invoicing and expense tracking yourself, while delegating more complex work like financial closing and tax declarations to us. You control how much work is delegated.
Question8: Do you help with setting up Odoo for accounting and payroll?
Answer8: Yes, as official Odoo partners, we provide complete implementation and configuration services. We ensure your Odoo setup meets Swiss accounting standards and that the payroll module is fully compliant with swissdec, providing a seamless and efficient system.
Question9: How do you manage swissdec-compliant payroll and insurance?
Answer9: We handle all aspects of payroll management through our swissdec-certified Odoo platform. This includes processing monthly salaries, generating payslips, and managing all electronic data transmissions for social security (AHV/AVS), pension funds (BVG/LPP), and withholding tax. We also manage all communications with insurance providers, including employee registrations, mutations, and annual declarations, to ensure you remain fully compliant.
Question10: How do I start a company in Switzerland as a foreigner?
Answer10: Foreign founders can incorporate in Switzerland, but the setup depends on nationality, residence status, and governance. In many cases at least one director must be Swiss- or EU/EFTA-resident with Swiss work authorization, while shareholders may remain abroad. We help structure the company, prepare apostilled identity documents, coordinate the bank and notary steps, and clarify immigration or nominee-director questions before filing.
Question11: How long does the incorporation process typically take?
Answer11: Once documents are prepared, standard incorporation takes about 1–2 weeks depending on the canton, bank capital confirmation, and notary availability. We help you avoid common delays.
Question12: Can you assist with opening a Swiss corporate bank account?
Answer12: Yes. We coordinate with partner banks, prepare required documentation, and support KYC onboarding. Options for remote onboarding may be available depending on the bank.
Question13: Do you support remote setup without visiting Switzerland?
Answer13: In many cases yes. With digital signatures, video identification, and couriered originals when necessary, we can complete most steps remotely. We clarify what can be done online for your case.
Question14: What are the main differences between setting up a company in Geneva vs Lausanne?
Answer14: Geneva offers strong international appeal and access to global organizations, with slightly higher costs but excellent infrastructure. Lausanne provides a more affordable option with growing tech scene and university connections. Both cantons have competitive tax rates, but Geneva has higher real estate costs. We help you choose based on your business needs.
Question15: What are the costs of a fiduciary in Geneva?
Answer15: For SMEs in Geneva, fiduciary fees usually depend on transaction volume, payroll, VAT complexity, and the amount of advisory support required. Ongoing accounting support often starts from CHF 149 per month for simple digital workflows, while broader annual mandates can range higher when payroll, tax filings, company secretarial work, or catch-up bookkeeping are included. We scope the work upfront and keep pricing fixed and transparent whenever the perimeter is clear.
Question16: What are the tax advantages of having a Swiss company?
Answer16: Switzerland offers competitive corporate tax rates (around 12-22% depending on canton), participation exemption for dividends, no withholding tax on dividends to foreign shareholders, and extensive tax treaties. Companies can benefit from R&D incentives and patent box regimes. We structure your setup to maximize these advantages legally.
